author: Sally Abou Aljoud
title: Lebanese Cabinet backs bill to return funds wiped out when banks collapsed
description: Lebanon’s Cabinet has approved a draft law to determine the extent of losses suffered by Lebanese banks during the country’s financial meltdown in 2019 and provide a mechanism to return depositors’ funds that were wiped out at the time. The financial collapse…
